name: Modern glass café
summary: Reads as a modern flat-roofed café with a plinth, terrace and CAFE sign, but the heavy dark-slab roof overpowers a thin glass pavilion, the glazing barely reads as floor-to-ceiling, and the back wall is blank.

log.summary: The terrace, tables, planters and railings read as a café, but a heavy black brick slab roof and dark brick walls turn the light glass pavilion into a dark bunker.
